"I keep it all in my head." I hear it from owners all the time. And it's true — right up until it isn't.

Your memory is a perfect system until you're out sick for a week. Or on vacation. Or your one guy quits on a Tuesday and takes three years of gate codes with him.

Then the business stops being a business and starts being a scramble. Phone calls. Guesswork. Stuff getting missed at properties nobody else has ever walked.

Here's the thing: your crew already texts you everything. What got done, what's needed, what's weird at the property. FieldNotes takes those same texts and turns them into searchable company knowledge — gate codes, access notes, visit history, follow-ups. Anybody on the crew can find it in seconds.

The knowledge stops living in one skull. Sick day, vacation, new hire — the business keeps its memory either way.

No app to install. No training. They text like they already do.

Try the 60-second demo: fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
30 days free, no credit card.
